tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lam zab tshar gsum khug pa rgyun khyer nyams su blang tshul sngags 'chang dbang po'i snying nor zhes bya ba bzhugs so// lam zab tshar gsum khug pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /'gro ba'i don du lam zab bsgom par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ rang nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba yi/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad zla'i steng / /bla ma bcom ldan don yod grub pa ni/ /margad mdog mtshungs rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /phyag g.yon mnyam bzhag g.yas pa skyabs sbyin mthil/ /sna tshogs rdo rje rin chen swā yis mtshan/ /thugs ka'i zla steng hūm̐ dkar 'od zer gyis/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas spyan drangs stim/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus gcig mchog rgyal por gyur/ /zhes pas bskyed la mos gus drag pos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin gsung / /bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin thugs/ /bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan grangs ci rigs pas gsol ba btab/ snying ga nas lha mo spros pas mchod par bsam/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ yang snying ga nas lha mo phyag g.yas ḍā ma ru dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas nang mchod phul bar mos la mtshan sngags mthar/ pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūm̐/ lha mo de rnams bla ma la thim pas byang sems zhu nas bde bas mnyes pas gsang mchod phul bar mos la mtshan sngags mthar/ bo dhi tsit+ta āḥhūm̐/ de nas bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes rgyas pas de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa phul bar mos la mtshan sngags mthar/ a ho su kha āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las/ /'phros pa'i 'od kyis sras bcas rgyal kun gyi/

/rdo rje gsum gyi byin rlabs spyan drangs bstim/ /rang gi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis mtshan/ /bla ma'i phyag g.yas rang gi gnas gsum du/ /rim dang gcig char reg dang lhan cig tu/ /bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po/ /oṃ gyi gzugs byung rang gi dpral bar thim/ /bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi rang bzhin gyur/ /snang stong zung 'jug ting 'dzin rgyud la skyes/ /bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dmar po/ /ā yi gzugs byung rang gi mgrin par thim/ /gsang ba'i dbang thob ngag gi dri ma dag /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi rang bzhin gyur/ /gsal stong zung 'jug ting 'dzin rgyud la skyes/ /bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od sngon po/ /hūm̐ gi gzugs byung rang gi snying gar thim/ /gsum pa'i dbang thob sems kyi dri ma dag /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rang bzhin gyur/ /rig stong zung 'jug ting 'dzin rgyud la skyes/ /bla ma'i yi ge gsum las 'od sna tshogs/ /'bru gsum gzugs byung rang gi gnas gsum thim/ /bzhi pa'i dbang thob sgrib pa'i bag chags dag /rgyal kun rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin gyur/ /bde stong zung 'jug ting 'dzin rgyud la skyes/ /mthar ni bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /bde stong zung 'jug blo 'das phyag rgya che/ /nges don snying po'i bla ma'i rang zhal blta/ /zhes brjod cing bde stong zung 'jug 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la ma bcos lhug par bzhag mthar/ skye ba kun tu sogs bsngo smon bkra shis gang 'os bya/ 'di nyid ma chag par nyams su blangs na rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur/ gal te nyams na myur du sor chud par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rje btsun rin po ches gsungs pas sngags sdom dag gtsang 'dod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis nyams len gyi snying por mdzad pa rigs so/

/zhes pa 'di'ang rang gzhan kun gyi ngag 'don bde ba'i slad du shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang legs pas drwa sgang sgrub sde bsam gtan phun tshogs gling du bris pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ lam zab tshar gsum khug pa rgyun khyer/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
